info.name: ResolveIQ API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the ResolveIQ API, generated from its OpenAPI description (tools/make-postman.js).

1. Import this collection and the "ResolveIQ local" environment, and choose that environment.
2. Put an account in the environment's "email" and "password" (they start empty on purpose).
3. Run "Log in" once. The tokens are saved for you, and every other request uses them.
The login token lasts 15 minutes; "Renew the login" swaps the refresh token for a new one.

item.name: 00 Quick tour (run this folder in order)
item.description: Fill in "email" and "password" in the environment with an Admin account (so every step is allowed), then run this folder with the Collection Runner. It signs in, creates an incident, reads it, comments, assigns it, starts work on it, reads the history, renews the login with the refresh token and signs out. Every step checks for a 2xx answer.
